sentence: This project studies how proteins that bind RNA help the malaria-causing parasite resist artemisinin drugs.
This project tries to find out how protein kinase C epsilon helps lung tumors develop and spread.
This project builds and tests a nature-based program, shaped by cultural teachings, that tries to reduce alcohol use and improve sleep in youth.
This project studies how fat that moves into heart tissue affects outcomes in people with heart disease.
This project tries to find therapeutic agents that manage inflammation caused by infection, which leads to early labor, and protect the fetus.
This project uses a method for solving structures of ion channels to find which subunits make up potassium channels in the mouse brain.
This project builds a biodegradable system that releases antibiotics when triggered by ultrasound, to prevent infection after spinal fusion surgery.
This project tests whether people with Down syndrome are more vulnerable to toxic chemicals in the environment, which may affect intellectual disability.
This project studies how proteins that help sense pathogens hold back inflammation.
This project brings together studies of cancer genetics, ways to reduce cancer risk, and ways to improve cancer outcomes.
This project works to understand and treat diseases of neurodegeneration, including the molecular basis of alcohol neuroadaptation and addiction.
This project provides light, electron, and cryo-electron microscopy imaging and image analysis for cancer research.
This project tests whether microbiota transplantation therapy is safe and works for teens with peanut allergy.
This project uses single-cell sequencing technologies to study how cancer mutations give cells a growth advantage over nearby cells.
This project extends access to clinical trials for children with cancer through community sites.
This project studies how environmental contaminants affect gene expression in the placenta and builds models that predict adverse pregnancy and birth outcomes.
This project builds an open-source computational framework that measures actin filament morphology in cryo-electron tomography data.
This project develops a targeted treatment for myasthenia gravis that does not suppress the immune system.
This project uses machine learning methods and biomarkers to spot acute kidney injury early and improve treatment of patients at risk.
This project tests whether myofibroblasts in pulmonary fibrosis are controlled by access to E-Box motifs and by proteins that bind them.
